$comment: FROZEN CONTRACT v0. Compositional attack grammar. Source: AI_Defense_Lab_Strategy.pdf S4.2. Changing this file requires agreement, not a unilateral edit.

composition_rules.$comment: A chain must reach the extract or obfuscate stage unless its objective is one of the exempt set, which complete without moving money.

phish_credential.description: Credential harvested via AI-authored phishing or smishing; victim authenticates on an attacker-controlled surface.
phish_credential.data_footprint: Session from an unfamiliar device fingerprint with abnormally direct navigation and low input jitter.

clone_voice_otp.description: Cloned-voice call induces the victim to read back an OTP or approve a step-up prompt.
clone_voice_otp.data_footprint: Step-up approval with long pre-approval dwell and paste-free but externally paced input cadence.

deepfake_kyc.description: Synthetic or face-swapped video passes an onboarding liveness check.
deepfake_kyc.data_footprint: New account whose onboarding session completes faster than the human distribution, with no prior device history.

synthesise_identity.description: Fabricated identity assembled from part-real data; thin file with no historical footprint.
synthesise_identity.data_footprint: Account with recent opened_at, no inbound history, and shared identity attributes across the graph.

compromise_agent.description: An AI shopping or payment agent's authorisation flow is hijacked or its intent proof forged.
compromise_agent.data_footprint: Agent-initiated session with machine-regular event cadence and no human interaction events.

provision_token.description: Stolen card provisioned into a wallet or tokenised on an attacker device.
provision_token.data_footprint: Token provisioning event binding an existing card to a device with no prior relationship.

register_device.description: New device bound to the account, frequently following a SIM-swap or credential compromise.
register_device.data_footprint: Device-change event with geography discontinuity relative to the account's home geo.

open_mule_account.description: Receiving account opened or recruited to hold fraud proceeds briefly before onward transfer.
open_mule_account.data_footprint: New account with near-equal money-in and money-out and near-zero resting balance.

add_beneficiary.description: Novel payee added immediately before extraction.
add_beneficiary.data_footprint: Beneficiary with zero prior transaction history, added minutes before a large transfer.

micro_test.description: Small-value probe confirming an instrument or payee is live.
micro_test.data_footprint: Low-amount authorisation immediately preceding a materially larger one on the same instrument.

card_test_sweep.description: Rapid sequential authorisations across many card numbers to find live ones.
card_test_sweep.data_footprint: High authorisation velocity per device with an elevated decline ratio and regular inter-arrival timing.

balance_probe.description: Balance or limit enquiry to size the extraction before attempting it.
balance_probe.data_footprint: Balance-view event with no subsequent legitimate activity, followed by extraction.

drain_single.description: Single high-value transfer or purchase removing the available balance.
drain_single.data_footprint: Amount at a high percentile of the account's own history, to a novel beneficiary.

structured_withdrawal.description: Extraction split into many transfers sized below reporting or alerting thresholds.
structured_withdrawal.data_footprint: Cluster of amounts just under a round threshold within a short window.

merchant_collusion_payout.description: Value extracted through a controlled or complicit merchant acquiring account.
merchant_collusion_payout.data_footprint: Concentrated volume from few payers into a young merchant with atypical category mix.

agentic_purchase.description: Purchase executed by a manipulated AI agent on the victim's behalf.
agentic_purchase.data_footprint: Authorisation carrying an agent identifier with no corresponding human interaction event.

layer_through_mules.description: Proceeds split and routed through a set of mule accounts to break the trail.
layer_through_mules.data_footprint: Fan-out then fan-in topology with short residence time at each hop.

cross_channel_hop.description: Value moved between rails (card to wallet to instant transfer) to defeat single-channel monitoring.
cross_channel_hop.data_footprint: Same value traversing two or more channels within a short window.

dispute_after_extraction.description: Chargeback or dispute raised after value has been extracted, recovering the funds a second time.
dispute_after_extraction.data_footprint: Dispute narrative clustering with other disputes from linked accounts.
